actions.action: Confirm only the explicitly selected slot
actions.mechanism: Bind review and confirmation to an immutable slot identifier, never its position in the changing week.
actions.implementation: Retain the selected identifier and booking details through refreshes. Send that identifier to the existing atomic endpoint; show unavailability without substituting another slot.
actions.check: Invalidate or reorder slots between selection and confirmation; verify no other slot is booked and failure preserves the reviewed details.
actions.risk: Displayed availability remains provisional until confirmation succeeds.

actions.action: Keep controls stationary while capacity updates
actions.mechanism: Update availability in place without moving focus, reordering slots, or relocating the confirmation control.
actions.implementation: Use fixed slot ordering and a persistent review area. At 320 pixels, show stacked days with keyboard-operable controls. Announce selected-slot changes politely; impose no countdown.
actions.check: During repeated updates, test keyboard and slow pointer journeys at 320 pixels: focus persists, controls remain reachable, and nothing overlaps.
actions.risk: Excessive announcements can obscure useful feedback; suppress unchanged messages.

actions.action: Offer explicit alternatives without losing preferences
actions.mechanism: Separate retained workshop, date, and time preferences from the selected slot so failures need not restart booking.
actions.implementation: After unavailability, retain filters and failed-slot details. Provide an explicit alternatives control; require deliberate selection and review before another atomic confirmation attempt.
actions.check: Force confirmation failure; verify preferences survive, keyboard focus reaches recovery controls, and no replacement is selected or submitted automatically.
actions.risk: Alternatives may also disappear; describe their availability as provisional.

actions.action: Measure recovery without making speed the objective
actions.mechanism: Evaluate understandable failure and preference-preserving recovery rather than optimizing selection-to-confirmation time.
actions.implementation: Record unavailable-confirmation outcomes, preference retention, and recovery completion. In accessibility tests, trigger invalidation at defined interaction stages, allow unlimited time, and include keyboard-only participants.
actions.check: Verify every induced failure identifies the original slot and offers reachable recovery. Report outcomes by input method without awarding faster completion.
actions.risk: Live failure rates reflect capacity contention; they cannot alone establish accessibility.
